name: architect
short: A second, independent LLM agent reachable only over A2A
description: Architect is a second, independent LLM agent -- never Discord-user-facing -- reachable over the A2A protocol on its own dedicated listener. Pico consults it as an A2A client. Shares corridor's LLM connection with pico. Serves pixelagents' built webview bundle under its own Dashboard route (/third-party/architect), rendering its own layout over its own office WebSocket server (/architect/ws) -- independent of floorplan's, not merely a copy of its static page. Edits that layout through a Semantic IR (rooms, zones, furniture, seats) via LLM tools and [p]architect office ... commands, both calling the same validated mutation service.
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends A2A task messages it receives to corridor's configured LLM endpoint. It does not persistently store any data or metadata about Discord users.
install_msg: Requires corridor and pixelagents (both auto-loaded). Configure the shared LLM connection with [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model (bot owner). The A2A listener starts automatically on 127.0.0.1:8931 -- change it with [p]architect a2a host/port. The webview needs Red Web Dashboard loaded and pixelagents' bundle built ([p]pixelagents webview rebuild); its live layout also needs the office WebSocket server (127.0.0.1:8932 by default, [p]architect ws host/port) reachable at the public path /architect/ws -- add a reverse-proxy rule for it alongside whatever rule already forwards floorplan's /ws.
